1. Kāya kamma (kamma that arises in body-door),1234567Mahavipāka 34
1. Pānātipātā veramani - abstinence from killing,Hadaya 63Hadaya 63Hadaya 63Hadaya 63Hadaya 63Hadaya 63Hadaya 63Hadaya 63Hadaya 63Kammaja Rūpa 30
2. Adinnādānā veramaņi - abstinence from stealing,
3. Kāmesumicchācārā veramani - abstinence from unlawful sexual relations.
2. Vaci kamma (kamma that arises in verbal-door),
1. Sacca vācā - telling the truth,
2. Apisuna vācā - abstinence from dividing friends from each other,
3. Saņha vācā - speaking kindly,
4. Manta vācā - talking wisely.
3. Mano kamma (kamma that arises in mind-door).
1. Anabhijjhā - non-covetousness,
2. Abyāpāda - non-hatred,
3. Sammā ditthi - right view.

Javana

Javana with one moment9/9 Mahaggata (Jhāna) Javanas, that are the first time.
2 Abhiñña Javana at any time.
4 Magga Javanas occur only one mental moment.They never repeat.
2 fruition (Phala) Javanas - Anāgāmi and Arahatta, occur once when they arise after with drawing from Nirodha samāpatti.
Javana with two or three moments2 Nevasaññā nāsaññāyatana javanas that precede to attain the Nirodha-samapatti.
The Fruition javanas preceded by Magga javanas arise 2 or 3 times.
Javana with four or five moments4 Paccavekkhaṇa javanas, that are the 4 Mahākriya javanas with knowledge within the Buddha, arise 4 or 5 moments when he creates a supernormal power as issuing the pair of water and fire.
Javana with five momentsThe Kāma javanas at the dying moment etc., due to weakness of the heart base, arise for five times.
Javana with six or seven momentsThe Kāma javanas in a Kāma mental process arise usually 6 or 7 moments.
Javana with unlimited momentIn the process of Jhāna and Phala attainment, the Javanas of Jhāna or Phala run without limitation. As long as the attainment remains these Javanas run like the current of Bhavaṅga citta
